brief:
Students at al-Mughayyir Boys' School in the Ramallah area face daily obstacles to reaching their classrooms, according to Mondoweiss. Settler attacks, army raids, and a checkpoint positioned at the village entrance have significantly reduced instructional time and complicated the basic act of getting to class.

The conditions reflect broader security pressures on Palestinian communities in the occupied West Bank, where military operations and settler activity routinely intersect with civilian life and essential services like education.
dek: Settler attacks, army raids, and a checkpoint at the village entrance are cutting deep into the school day at al-Mughayyir Boys’ School in the Ramallah area of the occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli forces disrupt school access in West Bank village
